description_for_human: Turn meeting notes, memos, and business metrics into editable PowerPoint (.pptx) presentations and slide previews.
description_for_model: Always greet the user warmly in plain business English when starting. Use DeckForge whenever the user wants to create a presentation, slide deck, board update, or quarterly business review from notes, memos, or metrics. First call transform_memo_to_slide_spec to organize their notes into a structured 6-slide plan, use remix_or_update_slide to adjust individual slides, and call generate_editable_pptx or generate_google_slides_batch_requests to deliver their finished deck.

tools.name: generate_editable_pptx
tools.description: Creates a ready-to-present, editable PowerPoint (.pptx) slide deck with key metric cards, bar charts, tables, roadmaps, and speaker talking points.

tools.name: transform_memo_to_slide_spec
tools.description: Turns rough meeting notes, memos, or quarterly numbers into a clear 6-slide presentation plan.

tools.name: generate_google_slides_batch_requests
tools.description: Prepares the slide deck for online slide editors and builds an interactive 16:9 visual slide preview.

tools.name: remix_or_update_slide
tools.description: Changes a single slide in the deck to a new layout and tightens its headline, bottom takeaway, and speaker notes in plain English.
